title: 第13章 给你内定了个影后
content_zh:
“百分之三十吧。”

    “这没得商量。”长宗不二说道。

    谷川说道：“加一百万，把日本版权给你。”

    “不行，加一百万，给你留中国版权。”

    谷川说道：“我把非洲版权也给你，这是我的底线了！”

    “非洲版权还是留给你自己吧。”长宗不二咬着牙说道。

    非洲版权？

    玩笑一样的东西，那东西值钱吗？

    谷川板着脸说道：“既然非洲版权满足不了你，那把南极洲的版权也给你好了。”

    “你不要无理取闹！”长宗不二说道。

    他态度坚定的说道：“百分之八十的全球版权，是我的底线。如果你不满意，那国内的票房分成，我一分钱都不要了！”

    “不行，百分之八十太多了，我费心费力的给你拍电影做什么？”

    “这是底线！”

    “那我不拍了！”

    谷川一拍桌子，就要走人。

    而且还不像是那种做样子的，直接打开包间的门走了出去。

    长宗不二都懵了。

    不是？

    这就不拍了？

    你不拍了，我那么多酒不是白喝了吗？

    关门的声音把长宗不二的思绪给拉了回来。

    长宗不二踉跄的起来，连忙冲出门外，找到正在付钱的谷川，急忙拉着他说道：“再商量商量啊，你急什么？”

    他拽着谷川的胳膊往包间走，软磨硬泡着，终于给拽了回来。

    “你一点诚意都没有。”谷川不满的说道：“满脑子都是生意，一点艺术都不讲。”

    长宗不二嘴角抽了抽。

    我满脑子都是生意，你脑子里就没有了？

    一路货色，谁都不要说谁好吧。

    果然是从美国回来的，对钱看的非常重。

    “再谈谈。”长宗不二语气软了一些。

    他是真的欣赏谷川啊。

    这样的身份、这样的才华再加上这样的电影，随便包装一下，他就是比陆穿还厉害的新生代最强导演。

    他对国内的破坏，是可以非常大的啊。

    两人经过激烈的谈判，最终还是达成了一致。
content_en:
"Thirty percent."

    "This is non-negotiable." Nagazune Fuji said.

    Tanigawa said: "Add one million and give you the Japanese copyright."

    "No, I'll add one million and I'll leave you with the Chinese copyright."

    Tanigawa said: "I will give you the African copyright. This is my bottom line!"

    "Leave the African copyright to yourself." Nagamune said through gritted teeth.

    African copyright?

    It's like a joke, is it worth anything?

    Tanigawa said with a straight face: "Since the copyright in Africa cannot satisfy you, then I will give you the copyright in Antarctica."

    "Don't make trouble unreasonably!" Chang Zongfuer said.

    He said firmly: "Eighty percent of the global copyright is my bottom line. If you are not satisfied, then I don't want a penny from the domestic box office share!"

    "No, eighty percent is too much. Why should I bother making a movie for you?"

    "This is the bottom line!"

    "Then I won't take pictures!"

    Tanichuan slapped the table and was about to leave.

    And he didn't look like the kind of person who just opened the door to the private room and walked out.

    Changzong Fuji was stunned.

    no?

    No more filming?

    If you don’t take pictures, didn’t I drink so much wine in vain?

    The sound of the door closing brought Nagamune out of his thoughts.

    Nagamune staggered up, rushed out the door, found Tanigawa who was paying, and hurriedly pulled him and said, "Let's discuss it later. What are you in a hurry for?"

    He dragged Tanichuan's arm toward the private room, rubbed it softly, and finally pulled it back.

    "You have no sincerity at all." Tanichuan said dissatisfied: "You are all about business and don't care about art at all."

    The corners of Changzong Fuji's mouth twitched.

    My mind is full of business, but yours is gone?

    It's all good stuff, no one should say who's good.

    As expected, he came back from the United States and takes money very seriously.

    "Let's talk more." Nagazune Fuji's tone became softer.

    He really appreciates Tanichuan.

    With such an identity, such talent, and such a movie, if you package it casually, he is the strongest director of the new generation, even more powerful than Lu Chuan.

    The damage he can do to the country can be very great.

    After intense negotiations, the two finally reached an agreement.
title_en: Chapter 13 I’ve appointed a movie queen for you
